cards.card_text: They're a byword among the nations and a laughingstock, and shame covers his face at the voice of the scorner and the reviler, the enemy bent on revenge.
cards.verse_text: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face, at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
cards.snippet: …shame has covered my face, at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
